test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Among five boxes A, B, C, D, and E. B is thrice as heavy as A. C is 40 kg heavier than E. D is three and a half times as heavy as E and C is five times as heavy as A. The weight of E is 40 kg. Which object is the lightest of all and what is its weight?
solution:
Given:

Five boxes A B C D and E

1) B is thrice as heavy as A.

=> B = 3A **---------- eq. (i)**

2) C is 40 kg heavier than E.

=> C = 40 + E **---------- eq. (ii)**

3) D is three and a half times as heavy as E.

=> D = 3.5E **---------- eq. (iii)**

4) C is five times as heavy as A.

=> C = 5A **---------- eq. (iv)**

5) The weight of E is 40 kg.

=> E = 40 kg **---------- eq. (v)**

Putting the value if E in eq. (ii) and (iii)

=> C = 40 + E = 40 + 40 = 80 kg **---------- eq. (vi)**

=> D = 3.5E = 3.5 × 40 = 140 kg **---------- eq. (vii)**

Putting the value of C in eq. (iv)

=> C = 5A

=> 80 = 5A

=> A = 80 ÷ 5

=> A = 16 **---------- eq. (viii)**

Putting the value of A is eq. (i)

=> B = 3A = 3 × 16 = 48** ---------- eq. (ix)**

From eq. (vi), (vii), (viii) and (ix)

=> 16 A 

Hence, “A” is the lightest of all and its weight is **"16 kg"**.
